node.statement: Fixed lift and near-adjoint bound. Apply the class-first phase clause of lem-stage1-bound-quotient-index-data to the extra fixed class from node 1.10: bind U_0 in calU_e and c,a in U(1) with [U_0]=breve-U, sigma(U_0)=c*U_0 and a^2=c, and set U=a*U_0. The exported covariance sigma(zV)=conj(z)*sigma(V) gives sigma(U)=conj(a)cU_0=aU_0=U because c=a^2 and |a|=1; also [U]=[U_0]=breve-U and U lies in calU_e. The literal package estimate then gives ||U-U^dagger||=||sigma(U)-U^dagger||<=C_grp*epsilon_r<=C_fix*epsilon_r.
